prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a high-end fashion magazine cover in a fictional Met Gala-style red-carpet event. Use the uploaded approved adult face reference for strict facial identity preservation. The clearly adult woman has a confident smile, bold red lip and dark hair blowing dramatically in the wind. She walks away while turning her head about 45 degrees to look at the camera, with elegant posture and a tasteful fashion backless design. She wears a futuristic liquid-metal silver gown reflecting direct camera flashes with sequin texture, a diamond choker and large stud earrings. Set the scene on a dark night red carpet with chaotic paparazzi cameras, red velvet ropes and bursts of flash bokeh. Use direct paparazzi-style flash, high-contrast hard light, sharp shadows behind the subject and bright reflections on the dress. Compose as a vertical 3:4 magazine cover with a large Harper's BAZAAR-style masthead treatment and the supplied Chinese cover text 红毯之夜, 独家直击 and 年度时尚大典. Preserve the approved adult identity, rear-facing pose, silver gown and red-carpet concept without adding a public-figure likeness.
